scenes.conflict: Tobias fears that speaking out will destroy the Guild's neutrality and standing, and he urges her to wait.
scenes.goal: Wren wants Guildmaster Tobias to publish her survey showing that the skybridge decay follows a pattern and is accelerating.
scenes.outcome: Tobias refuses to publish openly but agrees to quietly let Wren carry copies of her maps to those who can act, starting with the Wardens.
scenes.summary: In the lantern-lit Guild hall, Wren lays out her re-survey of the archipelago and the dimming anchors it predicts. Tobias, torn between caution and conscience, grants her a limited, unofficial mandate.

scenes.conflict: The Guild's neutrality and Tobias's caution clash with her urgency, and the central anchor she must observe is crowded with islanders who dismiss her warnings.
scenes.goal: Wren wants to confirm her prediction by watching the span her maps flag as next to unravel.
scenes.outcome: The predicted anchor dims on schedule, proving her maps right, and Tobias admits the Guild can no longer stay silent but still pushes the matter to the proper channels.
scenes.summary: Wren watches the central skybridge anchor at night and sees a strand fade exactly as her charts foretold. The shock galvanizes her while leaving Tobias shaken yet still hesitant to go public.

scenes.conflict: Kest distrusts the Guild and the old enclaves, resents their neglect of the fallen Hollow Span, and demands payment while hiding his smuggling routes from her.
scenes.goal: Wren needs a glider guide who knows hidden routes between islands to carry her maps across the archipelago.
scenes.outcome: Kest agrees to guide Wren for profit, and she pays him with her own savings, while he privately intends to use the journey as leverage for the Hollow Drift.
scenes.summary: Wren flies to the broken arches of the Hollow Drift to find a courier. Kest drives a hard bargain, and the pair strike an uneasy deal, each assuming the other can be used.

scenes.conflict: Garrick dismisses her maps as a child's drawings because acknowledging them would undermine his Tribute Edict, and he also seeks Kest over unpaid tribute.
scenes.goal: Wren wants Warden-Chief Garrick to examine her maps and open anchor repair knowledge to a shared weaving.
scenes.outcome: Garrick bars Wren from the anchors and orders Kest seized, forcing the pair to flee, though Garrick privately keeps a copy of her warning in mind.
scenes.summary: In the hold of metallic-barked trees, Wren presents her findings. Garrick's pride and the presence of a wanted smuggler turn the meeting into a confrontation, and the two escape by glider.

scenes.conflict: Isolde holds that the decay is a natural cycle and that meddling will bring a worse unraveling, and she rejects Wren as a meddler.
scenes.goal: Wren hopes to persuade Isolde to share the starlight weaving songs needed to repair the bridges.
scenes.outcome: Isolde refuses to teach the songs, but notices that Wren's decay pattern matches her own wind-readings and is quietly unsettled.
scenes.summary: Wren and Kest land among the needle-thin peaks. Isolde listens with serene disdain, yet a detail in the maps echoes the drift she has sensed in the winds.

scenes.conflict: Garrick threatens to cut off the Guild's access to anchor maintenance, testing the Guild's neutrality at the moment Wren's findings are proven.
scenes.goal: Garrick wants Tobias to withhold the Guild's survey data, while Tobias wants to keep the Guild respected and safe.
scenes.outcome: Tobias refuses to hand over the survey and resolves to invoke Accord customs, setting him on the path to publicly backing Wren.
scenes.summary: Garrick arrives at Lantern Reach to press the Guildmaster. Tobias, stung by Wren's courage and the failing anchor, decides that silence is no longer neutrality.

scenes.conflict: The Wanderers are split on cooperating with enclaves that ignored the Hollow Span's fall, and Kest sabotages an offer of help out of deep distrust of authority.
scenes.goal: Wren wants the Drift Wanderers to join the alliance, and Kest wants real protection and repair for his people.
scenes.outcome: Wren breaks Guild neutrality by promising to put the Hollow Drift's repair first, and Kest begins to trust her, though many Wanderers remain doubtful.
scenes.summary: Among the shattered arches, Wren hears the refugees' stories and realizes evidence alone will not persuade them. She pledges herself to their cause, and Kest shifts from paid guide to ally.

scenes.conflict: Garrick's pressure and the Guild's own fear of losing standing split the Guild, and the Accord is a widely ignored custom.
scenes.goal: Tobias wants to invoke the Lantern Accord to force the enclaves to hear the maps, and Wren needs the Guild's backing.
scenes.outcome: Tobias publicly backs Wren, spending his credibility to call a hearing of the enclaves at Lantern Reach, but Garrick vows to bar Ironroot from attending.
scenes.summary: Tobias stands before the Guild and uses Accord law to demand a gathering of the enclaves. The act of defiance costs him dearly but opens the door for a final reckoning.

scenes.conflict: Without the starlight songs the Wardens cannot weave the repair, and Garrick's pride and the tribute he demanded stand in the way of accepting help from the Wanderers he hunted.
scenes.goal: Garrick wants to repair the dimming anchor in his own hold using only Warden craft, while Wren and Kest try to warn him.
scenes.outcome: The repair fails and Garrick faces ruin, forcing him to concede that Wren's maps are right and that the Wardens cannot save the archipelago alone.
scenes.summary: An anchor in Ironroot Hold dims just as the maps predicted. Garrick's smiths fail to restore it, and the proud Warden-Chief is forced to confront his own flaw.

scenes.conflict: Isolde's doctrine of non-intervention collides with the evidence of the failing anchors and her doubt over whether withholding the songs is faith or fear.
scenes.goal: Wren and Kest want Isolde to teach the starlight songs now that the maps and the winds agree, and Isolde must decide what her faith demands.
scenes.outcome: Isolde accepts that her songs are the key to repair, redefines her faith as stewardship, and agrees to teach the verses at the gathering.
scenes.summary: As the winds shift and another strand fades, Isolde compares her readings to Wren's charts and finally chooses to share the weaving songs.

scenes.conflict: Old grievances over tribute, neglect and doctrine erupt, and the central anchor is nearly dark with the night short and the weaving songs unshared.
scenes.goal: Wren must unite the Wardens, Storm Singers and Wanderers to re-weave the central skybridge before it unravels.
scenes.outcome: Wren persuades the factions with shared stories as well as maps, and Garrick opens Warden craft while Isolde teaches the verses, so the enclaves agree to a joint weaving that night.
scenes.summary: At the Accord gathering, Wren breaks neutrality and speaks for the whole realm, weaving the stories of each enclave into one case. Garrick, Isolde and Kest each yield something of their pride.

scenes.conflict: The Wardens' anchor-forging and the Storm Singers' songs must be coordinated for the first time, and the resonance stone is nearly dark with only the night to work in.
scenes.goal: The united enclaves must weave starlight into the central skybridge anchor before it fully unravels and the archipelago scatters.
scenes.outcome: The anchor blazes back to life and the central span is restored, proving that shared effort can mend the bridges.
scenes.summary: Under the stars, Garrick tunes the resonance stone, Isolde leads the verses, Kest ferries materials by glider and Wren's maps guide each strand. The central skybridge shines whole again.

scenes.conflict: Many Wanderers still distrust the Wardens, and Garrick's pride resists acknowledging his part in the neglect.
scenes.goal: Wren and Kest want the promise of repair for the Hollow Drift fulfilled, and Garrick must answer for the tribute he demanded.
scenes.outcome: Garrick ends the tribute for the Drift and the Wardens begin repairing the Hollow Span, and Kest persuades the Wanderers to join the alliance.
scenes.summary: Garrick arrives at the broken arches with his smiths, humbled, and begins the work. Kest vouches for him to the Wanderers, sealing their place in the new accord.

scenes.conflict: Some Storm Singers see this as a betrayal of non-intervention, and Isolde must defend her new view of faith as stewardship.
scenes.goal: Isolde wants to teach the weaving verses across the enclaves, and Wren wants to see the knowledge shared for good.
scenes.outcome: Isolde commits the Storm Singers to teaching the starlight songs openly, making repair a shared craft among the enclaves.
scenes.summary: In the winds of the Spires, Isolde instructs the first students from every enclave. Wren listens, understanding that her maps were only the beginning.

scenes.conflict: The Guild's neutrality vow has been broken and Wren must reconcile that with the person she became, while the bridges still need ongoing care.
scenes.goal: Wren wants to chart the renewed archipelago, and Tobias wants to define the Guild's place in it.
scenes.outcome: Tobias names Wren a full cartographer and the Guild commits to publishing its survey openly, while Wren and Kest set out to chart the next bridges to mend.
scenes.summary: Back in the lantern-lit city, Wren draws a new map with the rewoven spans glowing across it. She and Kest depart by glider as the realm, though fragile, holds together.

logline: When apprentice cartographer Wren Alder's maps reveal that the skybridges are failing at an accelerating rate, she must cross rival enclaves and break the Guild's neutrality to persuade the Wardens, Storm Singers and Wanderers to re-weave the bridges before the archipelago drifts apart.
theme: Unity is woven from shared stories, not from evidence alone
title: The Skybridge Chronicles
